meta.title: Escalate: the AI agent that fights for your refund
meta.description: Open-source, self-hosted agent that takes a consumer complaint from first message to consumer court. You approve every message.

common.demoFailed: Couldn't load the demo cases. Is the API running?

lang.label: App language
lang.notTranslated: This language isn't translated yet, so you're seeing English.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or the case was deleted.

pack.localHint: A playbook written for this country's rules and sources.
pack.genericHint: No local playbook yet: a general international ladder. Check your local rules.

picker.count: {count} countries. Money and dates follow each country's own format.
picker.localExplain: There's a playbook for this country, with its own steps and official sources.
picker.genericExplain: No local playbook yet. You'll get a general international ladder that works anywhere; it doesn't know your country's laws, deadlines or courts, so check your local rules.

reasons.first_step: This is the first step: most disputes are settled by a clear written demand.
reasons.after_verdict: The last step got "{verdict}" ({step}), so the playbook moves up a rung.
reasons.skipped: Skipped "{step}": its condition doesn't apply to this case.
reasons.wait: They get {days} days to reply before the next step.
reasons.proof: Keep proof of delivery ({proof}): the next step needs it.
reasons.deadline_late: A deadline has passed ({rule}). The playbook adds a request to excuse the delay.

level.generic: generic international route: check your local rules

approve_draft.title: Review and approve the draft
approve_draft.body: Your letter for "{step}" is ready. Nothing is sent until you approve it.

questions.title: Answer a few questions
questions.body: The agent needs a few facts it couldn't find in your evidence.

urgent_checklist.title: Do the urgent steps first
urgent_checklist.body: In a scam, the first hours matter. Call your bank before anything else.

confirm_delivery.title: Send it yourself, then confirm
confirm_delivery.body: This step goes by post, web form or court. Print it, deliver it, then upload your proof.

waiting_reply.title: Waiting for their reply
waiting_reply.body: If they haven't replied by {when}, the agent prepares the next step for you.

start.title: Add evidence to start
start.body: Upload a receipt, screenshot or email so the agent can read the facts.

resolved.title: Resolved
resolved.body: This case is closed. Well done for not giving up.

closed_unresolved.title: The ladder is finished
closed_unresolved.body: Every step has been taken. Export the case file if you go to court yourself.

withdrawn.title: Withdrawn
withdrawn.body: You stopped this case. Nothing more will be sent.

none.title: The agent is working
none.body: Nothing needed from you right now.

progress.note: Nothing is sent while the agent works. You approve every message.

steps.playbook: Choosing the playbook for your country
steps.draft: Drafting the letter from the template
steps.check: Fact-checking every number, date and ID

model_offline.title: The AI model is offline
model_offline.body: Escalate couldn't reach your AI model. Start it (for example Ollama) or pick another source in Settings, then try again.

offline_api.title: Can't reach Escalate
offline_api.body: The Escalate API at {url} isn't answering. Start it with `make up` or `uv run uvicorn escalate.api.main:app`.

fact_check.title: Blocked by the fact check
fact_check.body: The letter has a value that isn't in your evidence.

rate_limited.title: Too many new cases
rate_limited.body: Please wait a little before opening more cases.

blocked.title: Draft blocked by the fact check
blocked.body: Every amount, date and ID must come from your evidence or your answers. Fix these before you can approve.
blocked.noMatch: No matching fact. Remove it, or add it as a fact first.

account_id.label: Account or member number
account_id.why: So the company can find your account straight away.

amount.label: Amount paid
amount.why: The letter must state exactly how much is at stake.

authority_contact.label: Consumer authority contact
authority_contact.why: Where the complaint to the authority is sent.

authority_name.label: Consumer authority
authority_name.why: The official body for this step. Use the name on its official website.

bank_contact.label: Bank fraud team contact
bank_contact.why: Where the fraud report goes. Use the contact on your bank's official website or card.

bank_name.label: Bank or card issuer
bank_name.why: The fraud report is addressed to them.

buyer_address.label: Your postal address
buyer_address.why: Legal notices and court forms must include it.

buyer_contact.label: Your phone or email
buyer_contact.why: So they can reply to you.

product.label: Product or service
product.why: Names what you bought, for the letter and the case title.

buyer_name.label: Your full name
buyer_name.why: Letters are signed with it and the company needs it to find your order.

cancel_requested_on.label: Date you asked to cancel
cancel_requested_on.why: Charges after this date are the ones you can claim back.

card_issuer.label: Card issuer
card_issuer.why: Needed for the card dispute letter.

card_last4.label: Last 4 digits of the card
card_last4.why: Identifies the card. Never give the full number, PIN or security code.

cause_of_action_on.label: Date the dispute started
cause_of_action_on.why: Court time limits often count from this date.

charges_after_cancel.label: Charges after cancelling
charges_after_cancel.why: The letter lists what you want refunded.

commission_name.label: Consumer commission
commission_name.why: The body the complaint is filed with.

company_name.label: Company name
company_name.why: The letter is addressed to them.

court_name.label: Court name
court_name.why: Court forms must name the court you file in.

currency.label: Currency
currency.why: Amounts are written with their currency code.

defect_description.label: What went wrong
defect_description.why: A short, factual description makes the demand clear.

delay_reason.label: Reason for the delay
delay_reason.why: If a deadline passed, the court may excuse it for a good reason.

last_promise_on.label: Date of their last promise
last_promise_on.why: Shows how long they've kept you waiting.

last_promise_text.label: What they promised
last_promise_text.why: Quoting their own words is strong evidence.

notice_delivered_on.label: Date the notice was delivered
notice_delivered_on.why: The waiting period counts from delivery.

order_date.label: Order date
order_date.why: Dates the purchase; some time limits count from it.

order_id.label: Order number
order_id.why: So the company can find your order straight away.

paid_on.label: Date you paid
paid_on.why: Banks need it to trace the payment.

payment_method.label: How you paid
payment_method.why: Each payment method has a different way to dispute.

platform_name.label: Marketplace or platform
platform_name.why: If you bought through a marketplace, it's the next rung of the ladder.

police_station.label: Police station
police_station.why: The report is addressed to it.

remedy_wanted.label: What you want
remedy_wanted.why: A clear request (refund, replacement, repair) is easier to say yes to.

reporting_body.label: National reporting body
reporting_body.why: The official body for fraud reports in your country.

reporting_body_contact.label: Reporting body contact
reporting_body_contact.why: Where the report is filed. Use the official website.

scam_description.label: What happened
scam_description.why: A short timeline helps the bank and the police act fast.

scammer_contact.label: Scammer's number or profile
scammer_contact.why: Helps the police and platforms block them.

seller_address.label: Seller's postal address
seller_address.why: A legal notice must be delivered to an address, with proof.

seller_contact.label: Seller's email or contact
seller_contact.why: Where the first letter is sent.

seller_name.label: Seller or shop name
seller_name.why: The letter is addressed to them.

transaction_id.label: Transaction or reference ID
transaction_id.why: Banks trace payments by this reference.

questions.title: A few questions
questions.intro: The agent couldn't find {count, plural, one {# fact} other {# facts}} in your evidence. Answer what you can.
questions.whyDefault: The letter for this step needs it.
questions.noSecrets: Escalate never asks for passwords, PINs, one-time codes or full card numbers. Don't type them here.
questions.nothing: No questions waiting for this case.

hero.eyebrow: Open source · free · runs on your computer
hero.title: Don't give up on your refund.
hero.body: Escalate takes your complaint and your evidence and runs it up the ladder: a written demand, a final notice, the regulator, then consumer court. It drafts every letter, tracks every deadline and follows up when they go quiet.
hero.approve: You approve every message before it's sent.

how.title: From "we'll get back to you" to a court-ready file

s1.title: Tell your story
s1.body: In your own words. Pick your country: every country is supported.

s2.title: Add your evidence
s2.body: Receipts, screenshots, emails. The agent reads the facts and shows where each one came from.

s3.title: Approve each letter
s3.body: Every amount, date and ID is checked against your evidence. You approve, edit or reject.

s4.title: Climb the ladder
s4.body: No reply or a refusal? The agent drafts the next rung, on time, up to consumer court.

showcase.title: It shows its work
showcase.body: Every step comes with the reasons behind it and the playbook it followed, so you always know why a letter is going out and what happens next.

points.facts: Facts only: drafts can't invent amounts, dates, IDs or laws.
points.playbook: Country playbooks with official sources, or a generic route that says so.
points.deadlines: Deadlines tracked, with warnings before they pass.

global.title: Every country. Every currency.
global.body: Money and dates are written the way each country writes them. Where there's no local playbook, a generic route still works and says so.
global.moreLanguages: Letters and the app are in English for now. More languages are coming.
global.packsLoading: Checking which countries have local packs…
global.packsCount: {all} countries supported; {local} with a local pack so far.
global.packsNote: Local packs are written by contributors and must cite official sources.

safety.title: Built so it can't go rogue

approve.title: You approve everything
approve.body: Nothing is sent until you click approve. The AI has no way to send.

facts.title: Facts only
facts.body: Every number, date and ID is checked against your evidence. Your own edits too.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Runs on your computer with a local model. Evidence is encrypted; card numbers and codes are masked.

legal.title: Not legal advice
legal.body: A self-help tool. Letters say so, and playbooks cite their sources.

cta.title: Ready to stop waiting?
cta.body: It takes about five minutes to start. You stay in control of every message.

landing.footer: Escalate is a free, open-source self-help tool, not legal advice. Check the rules in your country.

intros.where: Your country picks the playbook, the currency and how dates are written.
intros.what: In your own words. Include what you bought, what went wrong and what they said.
intros.evidence: Receipts, invoices, screenshots, emails. The agent reads them and shows each fact it finds.
intros.missing: The agent needs these to write the first letter.
intros.review: Check the route and the facts, then review your first letter.

wizard.regionHint: ISO 3166-2 code, like the suggestions. Some playbooks differ by region.
wizard.regionInvalid: Use an ISO 3166-2 code: country, dash, region (for example the suggestions).
wizard.letterLanguageHint: The language the company will read. You can change it later.
wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: I bought… It stopped working after… They told me…
wizard.descriptionHint: At least a sentence or two. Don't include passwords, PINs or codes.
wizard.noSecrets: Escalate never asks for passwords, PINs or one-time codes. If someone does, it's a scam.
wizard.dropHint: Photos, PDFs or emails (.eml). Encrypted on your computer.
wizard.needsReview: hard to read: check the facts
wizard.encrypted: Files are encrypted at rest. Card numbers, IBANs and ID numbers are masked in the text.
wizard.genericWarning: There's no local playbook for this country and case type yet. This generic route works anywhere but doesn't know your local laws, deadlines or courts: check your local rules.

cases.title: My cases
cases.needsYouCount: {count, plural, one {# case needs you today} other {# cases need you today}}
cases.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {due today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
cases.overdue: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

empty.title: No cases yet
empty.body: Start your first case, or load four demo cases from four countries to see how it works. Demo cases are fictional and nothing is sent.

dashboard.noLadder: The ladder appears once the agent has picked a playbook.
dashboard.noFacts: No facts yet. Add evidence and the agent will read it.
dashboard.stalled: The agent stopped before finishing (often because the AI model was offline). Nothing was sent.

delivery.title: Confirm delivery
delivery.proof: Proof of delivery (receipt photo or PDF)

confirmDelete.title: Delete this case?
confirmDelete.body: This deletes the case, its evidence files, drafts and timeline from this computer. It can't be undone.

confirmWithdraw.title: Withdraw this case?
confirmWithdraw.body: The agent stops: no more drafts or reminders. Letters already sent stay sent.

review.title: Review: {step}

noDraft.title: No draft waiting
noDraft.body: There's no letter waiting for your approval in this case right now.

review.subject: Subject
review.editHint: Your edits are fact-checked too. Replace every [[blank]] before approving.
review.previewNote: Preview only. Switching asks the agent to redraft and fact-check it in this language.
review.noTemplate: There's no template in {language} for this step yet. The agent can still redraft it in this language from the English template; you'll review it before anything is sent.

decision.title: Send this letter?
decision.body: To {recipient} by {channel}. Nothing goes out until you approve.
decision.fillBlanks: Fill in {count, plural, one {# blank} other {# blanks}} first.
decision.fixFacts: Fix the values the fact check flagged first.
decision.youApprove: Only you can approve. The agent has no way to send.

checks.title: Safety checks
checks.facts: Every amount, date and ID is in your evidence
checks.tone: Firm and polite: no threats or insults
checks.no_secrets: No full card numbers, IBANs, ID numbers or codes

confirm.title: Approve and send?
confirm.body: This letter goes to {recipient} by {channel}. Once sent, it can't be unsent.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this draft?
rejectDialog.body: The agent writes a new draft. Tell it what to change.

reply.title: Log their reply
reply.notWaiting: This case isn't waiting for a reply right now.
reply.placeholder: Paste the email, chat message or letter text here…
reply.hint: The agent judges it against what you asked for.
reply.autoMove: No reply? On {when} the agent moves on by itself.
reply.overrideHint: The ladder is replayed from your verdict. Any new draft is discarded; nothing is sent.
reply.nextBody: The agent has prepared the next rung of the ladder.

urgent.title: Scam: urgent steps

banner.title: Act now. The first hours matter.
banner.body: Banks can sometimes stop or reverse a payment if you call fast. Do these steps before writing any letter.

urgent.generic: General steps: no local list for {country} yet
urgent.unverifiedDetail: We haven't verified the official contact yet. Find it on your government's official website.
urgent.acknowledged: Urgent steps done. The agent can now help with the letters.

never.title: Never share
never.card: Your full card number or security code
never.us: Escalate will never ask for these. Neither will your real bank.

recovery.title: Beware of "recovery" scams
recovery.body: People who contact you offering to get your money back for a fee are almost always running a second scam. Only deal with your bank and official bodies.

urgent.sourcePending: Official source still to be verified

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Everything is saved on this computer. Secrets are never shown again after you save them.

model.title: AI model
model.intro: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. A local model keeps your case on this computer.
model.ollamaHint: With Docker Compose the address is http://ollama:11434/v1; without Docker, http://localhost:11434/v1.
model.keyNone: Not needed for a local model
model.keyHint: Stored on this computer only. Never shown again.
model.cloudWarning: This is a cloud model: your case text leaves this computer, and free tiers may use it for training. Avoid real personal data or use a local model.

email.title: Email
email.intro: Approved letters go out from your own address, with any provider that supports an app password.
email.demoMode: Demo mode: emails are not really sent
email.portHint: Port 465 uses SSL; other ports (usually 587) use STARTTLS.
email.passwordNone: Create one in your email account's security settings
email.passwordHint: An app password, not your normal password. Escalate never asks for bank PINs or one-time codes.

region.title: Language and region
region.appLanguageHint: Untranslated languages show English. Help translate on GitHub.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Your cases are stored on this computer, not on a server.
privacy.encrypted: Evidence files are encrypted at rest.
privacy.masked: Card numbers, IBANs, ID numbers and codes are masked in logs and drafts.
privacy.noTracking: No analytics, no tracking, no third-party requests from this app.
privacy.cloud: Your AI model is in the cloud: case text is sent to it.
privacy.deleteBody: Delete every case, evidence file, draft and reminder on this computer.
privacy.confirmBody: Every case, evidence file, draft and timeline is deleted from this computer. This can't be undone.
